method: Lexical declaration discovery by anchored Python def/class and shell name() patterns; not an AST, may miss or misclassify declarations. Exact blob identity is whole-file identity, not proof of behavioral or Safety equivalence. Same names are review leads only.
limitations: Only six selected historical PRs; no execution or import of code.
Dev expected scope is Python and shell in assets/live, auto_tests/tools, installer_observer and test paths. Not all languages or paths.
No formal gate, writer, merge, release or equivalence approval.
